summary: Phase 2 (revised scope): round structure with configurable work/rest/round count (default 2:00/1:00/5), configurable commit key + foot-pedal/keyboard input source flag, continuous-motion pulse during pre-cue READY, pre-cue delay configurable up to 8s with validation, optional penalty counter feeding a during-rest clear-list. Phone-as-sensor descoped to Phase 2b (see phase-update.json + decision-memo.md). Engine grows two pure helpers (validateDrillConfig, pendingPenalties) with 11 new tests; store grows nextRound + clearPenalty actions + roundIndex/workEndAt/restEndAt/cleared/inputSource fields with 5 new transition tests; new settings module backed by a Dexie v2 settings store with 3 round-trip/defaults tests. 19 new tests added (47 total, all green). Lint/typecheck/build clean. Browser-verified by qa-playwright against all 6 retained acceptance criteria plus Phase 1 regression (zero console errors).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: USB foot pedal works as configurable input (rebindable commit key)
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C1 — rebound to F; idle hint reads 'Press F to commit.'; pedals enumerate as keyboards so this exposes the configurable mapping

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Keyboard input remains as fallback, flagged in session metadata
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C2 — banner shown on idle when source=keyboard; summary screen labels 'Input source: keyboard' vs 'Input source: pedal'; persisted on SessionRecord.inputSource
qa-playwright C3 (6 sub-checks) — HUD shows Round 1/2, work clock m:ss counts down, rest screen appears with rest clock, Skip rest advances to Round 2/2, end-of-final-round lands on Summary
qa-playwright C4 — .motion-pulse element visible during READY; screenshot 03-trainer-ready-pulse.png

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Pre-cue delay upper bound configurable up to 8s
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C5 — min=2000/max=8000 saved without error; max=9000 rejected with visible 'must be ≤ 8000ms' banner; validateDrillConfig unit tests cover boundary and inversion

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Optional penalty counter (false starts + hesitations → clear-list)
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C6 — one false-start press during pre-cue produced '1 penalty rep to clear' with 'Clear one' button; click drops to 'All clear'; pendingPenalties unit-tested for weights and clearing

gates.testing: 47/47 vitest tests pass; 19 new tests cover validateDrillConfig (7), pendingPenalties (3), round transitions (4), penalty/inputSource stamping (2), settings persistence (3). Every new behavior has a primary-path test plus at least one edge case (boundary, final-round, missing-row).
gates.dry: Settings save uses { ...DEFAULT_DRILL_CONFIG, ...settings } so engine defaults are not re-encoded in the form. Penalty count is a pure derivation over the existing rep stream — no parallel rep store. Rep-record construction remains in a single commitRep helper.
gates.drift: Phase 1 patterns extended: DrillConfig + SessionRecord get new fields; engine helpers stay pure; store stays orchestration-only. SessionRecord new fields are optional so Phase 1 stored rows still read cleanly without migration.
gates.planning: decision-memo.md rewritten for Phase 2; planning gate triggered by cross-layer change (engine + store + persistence + UI) and persistence schema bump.
gates.verification_sprint: Phase 1 verification sprint ran before any Phase 2 code was added — 28/28 tests, lint, typecheck, build all green. Re-confirmed against Phase 1 user flow in qa-playwright R1/R2 (Esc → Summary, recent sessions list).
gates.pre_commit_verify: scripts/phasekit-verify.sh runs lint + typecheck + tests; same gate as Phase 1.
gates.phase_split: Phase 2 originally bundled phone-as-sensor (WebRTC + companion + accelerometer). That sub-scope was moved to a new Phase 2b — see artifacts/phase-update.json and docs/PHASES.md. Approved phase numbering (Phase 1) is unchanged.

review.code_reviewer: APPROVE — no blocking issues. 6 non-blocking nits raised; top 3 applied (SettingsScreen.handleSave reuses DEFAULT_DRILL_CONFIG; acknowledgeFeedback added phase guard; RestScreen tick clears its own interval on hit zero).
review.qa_playwright: PASS — all 6 acceptance criteria + 2 Phase 1 regressions verified across 10 screenshots; zero console errors. Evidence in artifacts/phase2-verify/.

suggested_commit_message: phase-2: rounds, configurable input, motion indicator, penalty counter
